summary: .env.vault support is removed: config() no longer decrypts a .env.vault file when DOTENV_KEY is set (the DOTENV_KEY option, the DOTENV_KEY and DOTENV_CONFIG_DOTENV_KEY env vars and the DotenvConfigOptions.DOTENV_KEY type are gone; it always reads the plain .env), and the decrypt() export (plus _configVault/_parseVault) no longer exists

Preload configuration is removed in favour of the new dotenv run CLI: node -r dotenv/config no longer reads dotenv_config_<option>=value command-line arguments, and the dotenv/lib/env-options and dotenv/lib/cli-options subpath exports are gone; import 'dotenv/config' itself still works (but logged by default until 18.0.4, where 17.x preloads were quiet)
config()'s '◇ injected env (n) from .env' message is written to stderr (console.error) instead of stdout (console.log); debug lines stay on stdout
The random '// tip: …' suffix (dotenvx/vestauth promotions and option hints, present since 17.1.0) is dropped from the injection message, which now ends after the file list

DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH, DOTENV_CONFIG_ENCODING and DOTENV_CONFIG_OVERRIDE (and the new DOTENV_PATH/ENCODING/OVERRIDE/FAST names) now set defaults for every config() call, where before a direct config() call honoured only DOTENV_CONFIG_DEBUG and DOTENV_CONFIG_QUIET and the rest applied only through the dotenv/config preload

Options passed to config() now take precedence over DOTENV_* and DOTENV_CONFIG_* environment variables, where 17.2.0 documented the opposite (a DOTENV_CONFIG_* variable overrode code-set options such as {quiet: false})

import 'dotenv/config' (and node -r dotenv/config) defaults quiet to true again, so it prints no injection message unless DOTENV_QUIET=false or DOTENV_CONFIG_QUIET=false is set; 18.0.0 to 18.0.3 logged by default

populate()'s return type DotenvPopulateOutput declares its values as string | undefined instead of string, so under strict null checks a populated value must be narrowed before use as a string (a declaration correction; runtime unchanged)
